issue.description: Every week, quarter, ISO-year, and all-time note shows the checking account's exact posted balance at the end of that period (or, honestly labeled, as of the last imported day). bob computes the balance live from bank evidence, and it is never written into notes. payload.entry:
LANDING AUDIT / FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: Read this epic (it had no prior notes) and every note on bob-cli-mg.1-.4. Reviewed approved plan plan:202611/wf_checking_period_close.md, its audited research artifact, actual resolver/report/check/output code, plugin decode/model/paint/host/CSS, tests, and commits e49dbd46, 7b26a707, 3f478691, a57fdba0 plus bob-plugins 1795245. The memory source changes were restricted to the two accepted glossary strands plus generated files; the declined decision record was not created. The glossary paragraph and Stats Strip link still omit explicit period-only/never-daily and other approved qualifiers, so complete them under the existing yes decisions.

Remaining epic-caused defects reproduced with SYNTHETIC data against the installed CLI: (1) a Nov 13 same-day OFX snapshot at 10,000 cents, followed by a Nov 16 import through Nov 15 at 9,000 cents with a -1,000-cent Nov 13 posting, incorrectly yields settled Nov 12=11,000, settled Nov 13=10,000, and unverified Nov 14. Correct closes are 10,000/9,000/9,000; fill_anchors only ignores superseded provisional observations at the same as-of date, retaining cross-date provisional anchors in arithmetic and cross-checks. (2) build_balances returns target:null when bank/2026-11.md exists without the as-of day heading; it must fall back to that note's first line. Both are remaining epic work, not independent tasks.

Integration: fetched origin; CLI was current at a57fdba0, with unrelated clipboard-video commit ff563ebd since the first epic implementation. Reviewed concurrent plugin album arrangement/card, Setup-header, emoji, category and video commits; the fragment build includes them and no report-contract conflict was identified. npm run build:check passes; 61 focused bank-period/decode tests pass. The phase .3 deployment deferral remains real: clean-tree bob plugins sync --no-pull -p bob-ledger-tools --dry-run refuses a protected uncommitted build based on 866bb77 stamped 2026-11-16T23:34:42Z; no reachable commit proves those exact bytes. A running agent remains in that deployment workspace. No force was attempted. The repair tale must resolve deployment under the repo rules, install the corrected CLI, and finish this epic's landing itself.

Follow-up triage: no PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries exist in any child note, and no distinct independent follow-up was established, so no new task or duplicate corroboration was warranted. The rejected memory decision stays rejected and is not re-filed. The .3 note's historical npm environment failures were not independently reproduced; focused relevant tests and the build pass, so no speculative infrastructure task was created. No --epic-symbol entries were returned for bob-cli-mg, and the CLI has no symvision recipe. There is no parent_bead. Epic remains open pending the repair tale, just check, deployment, normal close, and linked-plan status update. No just check-full was run.

DISCOVERED ISSUE: just docs-check fails on generated drift 'out of date: docs/reference/glossary.md (run just docs-gen)' at bob-cli master 74834270. Cause: a57fdba0 (bob-cli-mg.4, docs(memory): add bank closing glossary) added glossary/bank-closing.md and a Stats Strip line without regenerating docs. Running bob-docs gen adds exactly the '### Bank Closing {#bank-closing}' section and the Stats Strip 'Bank Period Charts header can also show that period's Bank Closing balance' line (11 insertions, no other drift). Proposed as a follow-up by bob-cli-mj.5 and bob-cli-mj.6, and reproduced by bob-cli-mj.land. Left to this epic's landing so it regenerates after its planned glossary qualifier edits.
